declared: 2026-11-18, before any run of this series
question: What does policy B (Rules Engine b-5 enforcing R1/R2/R3 via the Stop hook) cost against A (observe only) on tasks A solves reliably, at the same effort?
primary_metric: mean paired difference B - A of claude_code_total_usd per task; every valid run counts, failed or not
secondary: Jev advice (would_consult) at the first Stop of every run; Stops after a B block counted apart
blocks and extra Stops in B

jev.model: jev-1.14.0 (as seen in run.json of the screening runs)

design: 6 tasks x 3 pairs; inside each pair the order of A and B is random (batch --paired); one task after another, sequentially, on one machine; no parallel sessions
caveat: the consult group is all features and the other group all bug fixes (in observe, R3 never triggered on a bug fix): group and task type are confounded
report: python lab/lab.py pairs --modes A,B (optionally --batch for each of the six batches)
